title: Story premise EDU081: The Caption That Lost the Speaker
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (accessibility/inclusion). Hook: Who said that when neither mouth was on screen? Takeaway/theme: Captions may need speaker and meaningful sound information as well as spoken words.
description: A viewer wants to follow a scene without its audio, but the caption shows words with no indication of which offscreen figure spoke. Reviewed speaker identification and meaningful sound labels restore the missing context.
